title: Anytime-Valid Risk Auditing with Pending Labels
selective_rule: High propensity when prediction uncertainty is at least the calibration median.
expedite_schedule: Up to 4 pending labels every 256 issued predictions; cap floor(0.02 N).
estimand: Realized average bounded loss of the issued prediction prefix.
uncertainty_reporting: Binomial intervals for independent synthetic repetitions; paired audit-seed bootstrap within predictor/data blocks for replay contrasts.
data_claim: Real public prediction tasks with experimentally imposed feedback mechanisms; feedback delays are not observed operational delays.
